Name: Ad spend
Definition: Ad spend (INR) by delivery date.

Name: Add to cart events
Definition: Add-to-cart events.

Name: Add to cart rate
Definition: Sessions with an add-to-cart ÷ sessions.

Name: Add to cart to checkout rate
Definition: Sessions reaching checkout ÷ sessions with an add-to-cart.

Name: Add to carts
Definition: Add-to-cart actions in sessions.

Name: AOV
Definition: Average order value incl. GST = total sales ÷ orders (D-02b).

Name: Available units
Definition: On hand minus reserved.

Name: Avg actual lead days
Definition: Mean days from order date to inventory posting (fulfilled requests only).

Name: Avg hours to resolve
Definition: Mean hours from failure to resolution (resolved errors only).

Name: Avg page depth
Definition: Average pages per session.

Name: Avg planned lead days
Definition: Mean days from order date to expected delivery.

Name: Avg sampling cogs
Definition: Mean COGS.

Name: Avg sampling margin pct
Definition: Mean (MRP - COGS) / MRP.

Name: Avg sampling mrp
Definition: Mean MRP.

Name: Avg seconds to add to cart
Definition: Average seconds from session start to first add-to-cart.

Name: Avg seconds to checkout
Definition: Average seconds to checkout (sparse).

Name: Avg seconds to purchase
Definition: Average seconds to purchase (sparse).

Name: Avg touch count
Definition: Average touches per attribution path.

Name: Break-even ROAS
Definition: Break-even ROAS = net sales ÷ contribution before ads. NULL when net sales <= 0; labelled on the event axis (D-31).

Name: Bid strategy changes
Definition: Bid strategy changes.

Name: Bounce rate
Definition: Share of sessions without a product view (funnel definition; ≠ single-page bounce).

Name: Budget changes
Definition: Budget changes.

Name: Cancel revenue
Definition: Sales cancelled before dispatch ex-GST (positive deduction).

Name: Cancelled orders
Definition: Sale orders with a cancelled (or Unknown) line, counted on the event date (D-37).

Name: CAC (by channel / campaign)
Definition: CAC = ad spend ÷ new customers, by channel / campaign (D-31).

Name: Channel cancelled orders
Definition: Sale orders with at least one cancelled (or Unknown) line, counted on the order's first outcome date on the event axis (D-37).

Name: New customers (by channel / campaign)
Definition: First placed orders of new customers (D-15).

Name: Orders (by channel / campaign)
Definition: Sale orders placed (exchange replacements, zero-value and test orders excluded, D-01 / D-08).

Name: Channel returned or cancelled orders
Definition: Returned + cancelled order counts (as v2).

Name: Channel returned orders
Definition: Sale orders with at least one customer-returned line.

Name: Channel rto orders
Definition: Sale orders with at least one RTO line.

Name: Channel unknown orders
Definition: Sale orders whose outcome evidence conflicts or is missing (D-22), booked as cancelled.

Name: Checkout fee
Definition: Checkout fee; not recorded before 2026-09 (D-11a).

Name: Checkout rate
Definition: Sessions reaching checkout ÷ sessions.

Name: Checkout steps
Definition: Checkout steps in sessions (sparse: checkout timing not populated for all brands).

Name: Checkout to purchase rate
Definition: Purchasing sessions ÷ sessions reaching checkout.

Name: Clicks
Definition: Clicks (all clicks).

Name: Cod handling fee
Definition: COD handling fee; not recorded before 2026-09 (cost_method not_recorded, D-11a).

Name: Cod orders
Definition: Cash-on-delivery sale orders.

Name: Collection view events
Definition: Collection view events.

Name: Contribution margin
Definition: Contribution before ads = net sales − net COGS.

Name: Contribution margin %
Definition: Contribution margin ÷ net sales. NULL when net sales <= 0; labelled on the event axis (D-31).

Name: Conversion rate
Definition: Purchasing sessions ÷ sessions.

Name: Cost per landing page view
Definition: Cost per landing page view = ad spend ÷ website landing page views (D-17, D-13r).

Name: Cost per link click
Definition: Cost per link click = ad_spend ÷ link_clicks.

Name: Cost per order (CPA)
Definition: Cost per order = ad spend ÷ orders placed (D-31).

Name: CPC
Definition: Cost per click = ad_spend ÷ clicks.

Name: CPM
Definition: Cost per 1,000 impressions.

Name: CTR
Definition: Click-through rate = clicks ÷ impressions.

Name: Customers
Definition: Persons (hashed key, guests matched, D-16a) with a sale order in the period, by last order.

Name: Discounts
Definition: Discounts ex-GST (memo: already deducted inside gross sales, D-09a).

Name: Discounts incl tax
Definition: Discounts incl. GST; tax-inclusive (D-02b).

Name: Add-to-cart events (events)
Definition: Add-to-cart events (event grain) — by product, SKU, traffic source or campaign.

Name: Collection views (events)
Definition: Collection views (event grain) — by collection, traffic source or campaign.

Name: Web events (events)
Definition: Events (event grain).

Name: Page views (events)
Definition: Page views (event grain) — by page, product, traffic source or campaign.

Name: Product views (events)
Definition: Product views (event grain) — by product, SKU, traffic source or campaign.

Name: Site searches (events)
Definition: Site searches (event grain) — by page, traffic source or campaign.

Name: Events per session
Definition: Events per session.

Name: Exchange cost
Definition: Net cost of exchange fulfilment: replacement product cost less credits and recovered stock, plus exchange shipping and handling (D-01).

Name: Exchange credit amount
Definition: Non-cash exchange credits on exchange replacements (gateway manual / store credit …); internal transfers, not cash (D-01b).

Name: Exchange price adjustment
Definition: Exchange value difference (replacement minus exchanged item), ex-GST, on the original sale (D-01a).

Name: Exchange refund count
Definition: Refund events on orders whose items were exchanged (kept visible, outside the return metrics, D-01 / D-20).

Name: Funnel purchases (orders)
Definition: Funnel purchases at order grain (the mart's purchases, sliceable by campaign and product).

Name: Funnel revenue (orders)
Definition: Revenue of the funnel purchases at order grain (net revenue ex-tax, the mart's revenue).

Name: Funnel purchases
Definition: Purchases seen in the web funnel (Snowplow) — not the orders count.

Name: Funnel revenue
Definition: Revenue of funnel purchases (Snowplow).

Name: Gross COGS
Definition: Product (landed purchase) cost of all placed units, no return adjustment (D-03).

Name: Gross profit
Definition: Gross profit = gross sales − gross COGS − ad spend.

Name: Gross ROAS
Definition: Gross ROAS = gross sales (attributed at placement) ÷ ad spend (D-09).

Name: Gross sales
Definition: Gross sales ex-GST at placement, after discounts (D-09a). Same figure as finance.gross_sales.

Name: Hold rate (15 s)
Definition: Hold rate = ThruPlays (15 s) ÷ 3-second video views (Meta).

Name: Hook rate
Definition: Hook rate = 3-second video views ÷ impressions (Meta).

Name: Impressions
Definition: Impressions.

Name: Inventory sync errors
Definition: Inventory posting failures.

Name: Items with layer gap
Definition: Items whose balance disagrees with their FIFO layers (usually unlayered manual adjustments); their FIFO value is understated.

Name: Landing page views
Definition: Landing page views = website sessions attributed to the platform / campaign / ad (UTM / click id) with at least one tracked page view (D-17, D-13r). Not the platform-reported figure. Sessions without a campaign / ad id sit on the 'campaign unknown' / 'ad unknown' members.

Name: Layered units
Definition: On-hand units that sit in open FIFO layers (the part of on_hand_units that stock_value_fifo values).

Name: Line fill rate
Definition: Received / ordered units on the lines.

Name: Line ordered units
Definition: Units ordered on the lines.

Name: Line received units
Definition: Units received (QC actual).

Name: Line value
Definition: Line value incl. GST.

Name: Link clicks
Definition: Link clicks.

Name: LTV
Definition: LTV = first-order net sales ex-GST of new customers ÷ new customers, by channel / campaign (v1 definition, cohort-only: refused on event_date, D-31).

Name: LTV:CAC ratio
Definition: LTV ÷ CAC (cohort-only; mixed clocks, refused on event_date, D-31 owner-confirmed 2026-10-15).

Name: MER
Definition: MER = net sales ÷ ad spend. NULL when net sales <= 0; on the event axis it is labelled (D-31).

Name: Movement value
Definition: Signed movement value at the movement's unit cost.

Name: Net AOV
Definition: Net AOV ex-GST = net sales ÷ orders. Mixed clocks: refused on event_date (D-31, owner-confirmed 2026-10-15).

Name: Net COGS
Definition: Net COGS = product cost + operating cost + exchange cost, net of returns.

Name: Net margin %
Definition: Contribution after ads ÷ net sales. NULL when net sales <= 0; labelled on the event axis (D-31).

Name: Net profit
Definition: Contribution after ads = contribution margin − ad spend. Opex is not in the warehouse, so this is not a true net profit (D-18, D-18r).

Name: Net ROAS
Definition: Net ROAS = contribution before ads ÷ ad spend. NULL when net sales <= 0; labelled on the event axis (D-31).

Name: Net sales
Definition: Net sales ex-GST (ledger): gross + shipping − cancelled − RTO − returned − shipping reversed ± exchange adjustment. Equals finance.net_sales.

Name: Net sales deductions
Definition: What net sales deducts: cancelled, RTO, returned and reversed shipping, ex-GST.

Name: Net stock change
Definition: Net units change (in minus out) over the period.

Name: LTV (by channel / campaign)
Definition: LTV by channel / campaign = first-order net sales ex-GST ÷ new customers (cohort-only, D-31).

Name: New customer net sales
Definition: Net sales ex-GST of first orders of new customers (numerator of ltv). Cohort-only (D-31).

Name: New customers
Definition: First placed orders of new customers (D-15).

Name: On hand units
Definition: Units on hand now.

Name: Open inventory sync errors
Definition: Posting failures not yet resolved.

Name: Open purchase orders
Definition: Purchase requests not yet fulfilled.

Name: Operating cost
Definition: Fulfilment and payment cost = shipping + packaging + gateway + COD + checkout + weight + provisional + reverse shipping.

Name: Ad spend (P&L basis)
Definition: Ad spend on delivery date, never allocated (D-07). Ignores date_axis.

Name: Cancel revenue (P&L basis)
Definition: Sales cancelled before dispatch ex-GST (positive deduction); Unknown outcomes are booked here (D-22h).

Name: Discounts (P&L basis)
Definition: Discounts ex-GST. Memo: already deducted inside gross_sales (D-09a), so not subtracted again in net sales.

Name: Gross sales (P&L basis)
Definition: Gross sales ex-GST at placement, after discounts (D-09a); the top line. Excludes shipping charged.

Name: Net sales (P&L basis)
Definition: Net sales ex-GST = gross sales + shipping revenue − cancelled − RTO − returned − shipping reversed ± exchange price adjustment.

Name: Return cancel revenue (P&L basis)
Definition: Cancelled + RTO + returned sales ex-GST: everything the old return+cancel id covered (v2 hid RTO inside it).

Name: Return revenue (P&L basis)
Definition: Sales of delivered orders returned by the customer ex-GST (positive deduction).

Name: Rto revenue (P&L basis)
Definition: Sales of shipped orders that came back undelivered (RTO) ex-GST (positive deduction). Separate from cancels and returns since v3 (D-05, D-22).

Name: Order value incl tax
Definition: Order value incl. GST at placement; tax-inclusive (D-02b).

Name: Orders
Definition: Sale orders placed. Exchange replacements, zero-value and test orders are not sales (D-01 / D-08).

Name: Orders with touchpoints
Definition: Orders with at least one recorded touch.

Name: Out of stock items
Definition: Items with nothing available (available <= 0).

Name: Overdue purchase orders
Definition: Open purchase requests past their expected delivery date.

Name: Packaging cost
Definition: Packaging cost (placed).

Name: Page views
Definition: Page views.

Name: Paid sales
Definition: What customers paid at placement INCLUDING GST, after discounts; tax-inclusive (D-02b).

Name: Payment amount
Definition: Cash payment amount (refunds negative). Non-cash exchange credits are separate (exchange_credit_amount, D-01b). Native cash clock (transaction date, D-36).

Name: Payment gateway fees
Definition: Payment gateway fees (placed, net as gold posts them).

Name: Payment orders
Definition: Sale orders with a recognised payment bucket (cod / online / manual / paytm card machine), as v2.

Name: Platform reported landing page views
Definition: Landing page views as the ad platform reports them. Diagnostic twin of landing_page_views, hidden by default (D-13r); never an ad metric.

Name: Po count
Definition: Purchase requests.

Name: Po fill rate
Definition: Received / ordered units (QC actual quantity).

Name: Po lines
Definition: Purchase request lines.

Name: Po ordered units
Definition: Units ordered.

Name: Po received units
Definition: Units received per quality check.

Name: Po value
Definition: PO value incl. GST and header freight.

Name: Prepaid orders
Definition: Prepaid (online) sale orders.

Name: Product ad spend (allocated)
Definition: Ad spend allocated to the product line: each campaign-day's delivery spread over the credited sale lines of that day by credit × line gross sales (D-27). A model, not platform-reported. Unallocated spend is its own 'Unallocated' row so totals reconcile with delivery.

Name: Product attributed contribution (allocated)
Definition: Contribution before ads of the product's ad-attributed lines.

Name: Product attributed net sales (allocated)
Definition: Net sales ex-GST of the product's ad-attributed lines.

Name: Product attributed revenue (allocated)
Definition: Gross sales ex-GST of the product's ad-attributed lines (default attribution model).

Name: Product break-even ROAS (allocated)
Definition: Product break-even ROAS = attributed net sales ÷ attributed contribution before ads.

Name: Product CAC (allocated)
Definition: Product CAC = allocated ad spend ÷ first-time-customer orders containing the product (paid-credited and organic lines, D-38).

Name: Product clicks (allocated)
Definition: Clicks allocated to the product line.

Name: Product cogs credit
Definition: Product cost credited back for every cancelled / RTO / returned unit (D-03a); follows its deduction on the event axis (D-30).

Name: Product contribution margin
Definition: Contribution before ads = net sales − net COGS.

Name: Product contribution margin %
Definition: Contribution margin ÷ net sales. NULL when net sales <= 0; labelled on the event axis (D-31).

Name: Product cost
Definition: Product cost net of the restock credit.

Name: Product cost per LPV (allocated)
Definition: Allocated spend ÷ allocated website landing page views.

Name: Product cost per link click (allocated)
Definition: Allocated cost per link click.

Name: Product cost per order (CPA) (allocated)
Definition: Allocated ad spend per order containing the product (paid-credited and organic lines, D-38).

Name: Product CPC (allocated)
Definition: Allocated cost per click.

Name: Product CPM (allocated)
Definition: Allocated cost per 1,000 impressions.

Name: Product CTR (allocated)
Definition: Allocated CTR.

Name: Product gross cogs
Definition: Product (landed purchase) cost of all placed units, no return adjustment (D-03).

Name: Product gross ROAS (allocated)
Definition: Product gross ROAS = attributed gross sales ÷ allocated ad spend.

Name: Product hold rate 15s (allocated)
Definition: Allocated ThruPlays ÷ 3-second views.

Name: Product hook rate (allocated)
Definition: Allocated 3-second video views ÷ impressions.

Name: Product impressions (allocated)
Definition: Impressions allocated to the product line.

Name: Product LPVs (allocated)
Definition: Website landing page views allocated by the same rule as spend (D-27b); not the platform figure.

Name: Product link clicks (allocated)
Definition: Link clicks allocated to the product line.

Name: Product LTV:CAC ratio (allocated)
Definition: Product LTV:CAC = net sales ex-GST of first-time-customer lines of the product ÷ its allocated ad spend (the brand LTV:CAC basis at product grain).

Name: Product MER (allocated)
Definition: Product MER = attributed net sales ÷ allocated ad spend.

Name: Product net margin % (allocated)
Definition: Product net margin = contribution after allocated ads ÷ attributed net sales.

Name: Product net profit (allocated)
Definition: Product contribution after allocated ads = attributed contribution before ads − allocated ad spend (opex excluded, D-18r).

Name: Product net ROAS (allocated)
Definition: Product net ROAS = attributed contribution before ads ÷ allocated ad spend.

Name: Product new customers
Definition: Distinct first-time-customer orders containing the product (D-15).

Name: Product operating cost
Definition: Fulfilment and payment cost = shipping + packaging + gateway + COD + checkout + weight + provisional + reverse shipping.

Name: Product ad spend (P&L basis) (allocated)
Definition: Allocated ad spend of the orders containing the product (as product_ad_spend; the id the product P&L used).

Name: Product cancel revenue (P&L basis)
Definition: Sales cancelled before dispatch ex-GST (positive deduction); Unknown outcomes are booked here (D-22h).

Name: Product cancelled orders (P&L basis)
Definition: Distinct orders with a cancelled (or Unknown) line of the product; on the event axis each counts on the date of its own line event (D-37).

Name: Product checkout fee (P&L basis)
Definition: Checkout fee; not recorded before 2026-09 (D-11a).

Name: Product cod handling fee (P&L basis)
Definition: COD handling fee; not recorded before 2026-09 (cost_method not_recorded, D-11a).

Name: Product discounts (P&L basis)
Definition: Discounts ex-GST. Memo: already deducted inside gross_sales (D-09a), so not subtracted again in net sales.

Name: Product exchange cost (P&L basis)
Definition: Net cost of exchange fulfilment: replacement product cost less credits and recovered stock, plus exchange shipping and handling (D-01).

Name: Product exchange price adjustment (P&L basis)
Definition: Exchange value difference (replacement minus exchanged item), ex-GST, on the original sale (D-01a).

Name: Product gross sales (P&L basis)
Definition: Gross sales ex-GST at placement, after discounts (D-09a); the top line. Excludes shipping charged.

Name: Product net cogs (P&L basis)
Definition: Net COGS = product cost + operating cost + exchange cost, net of returns.

Name: Product net sales (P&L basis)
Definition: Net sales ex-GST = gross sales + shipping revenue − cancelled − RTO − returned − shipping reversed ± exchange price adjustment.

Name: Product product cogs credit (P&L basis)
Definition: Product cost credited back for every cancelled / RTO / returned unit (D-03a); follows its deduction on the event axis (D-30).

Name: Product product cost (P&L basis)
Definition: Product cost net of the restock credit.

Name: Product provisional ops cost (P&L basis)
Definition: Provisional one-lump operating cost estimate used until the actual split is posted (cost_status provisional).

Name: Product return cancel revenue (P&L basis)
Definition: Cancelled + RTO + returned sales ex-GST: everything the old return+cancel id covered (v2 hid RTO inside it).

Name: Product return revenue (P&L basis)
Definition: Sales of delivered orders returned by the customer ex-GST (positive deduction).

Name: Product returned or cancelled orders (P&L basis)
Definition: Distinct orders with a returned or cancelled line of the product (as v2).

Name: Product returned orders (P&L basis)
Definition: Distinct orders with a customer-returned line of the product (D-22, D-37).

Name: Product rto revenue (P&L basis)
Definition: Sales of shipped orders that came back undelivered (RTO) ex-GST (positive deduction). Separate from cancels and returns since v3 (D-05, D-22).

Name: Product shipping revenue (P&L basis)
Definition: Shipping charged to the customer ex-GST, an order-level revenue line (D-10).

Name: Product shipping revenue reversal (P&L basis)
Definition: Shipping revenue reversed on cancelled / RTO / Unknown orders (positive deduction, D-10a).

Name: Product weight discrepancy cost (P&L basis)
Definition: Courier weight-discrepancy charges; not recorded before 2026-09 (D-11a).

Name: Orders with the product
Definition: Orders containing the product / variant (distinct root orders with a sold line). Summed over products this exceeds the order count (D-34).

Name: Product packaging cost
Definition: Packaging cost (placed).

Name: Product payment gateway fees
Definition: Payment gateway fees (placed, net as gold posts them).

Name: Product refunded amount (ex-GST)
Definition: Refunded amount ex-GST of the refunded lines (refund date), splittable by product / variant / SKU — excludes refund-level adjustments that belong to no line. Refunds of exchanged items are excluded: exchanges never enter return metrics (D-01); the refund date is a native cash clock and ignores date_axis (D-36).

Name: Product return rate
Definition: Product return rate = orders with a customer-returned line of the product ÷ orders containing it. Cohort-only: refused on event_date (D-31); use order_date.

Name: Product returns value (ex-GST)
Definition: Returns value ex-GST of the refunded lines (refund date), splittable by product / variant / SKU. Refunds of exchanged items are excluded: exchanges never enter return metrics (D-01); the refund date is a native cash clock and ignores date_axis (D-36).

Name: Product RTO cost
Definition: Reverse shipping cost of RTOs and returns (gold rto_cost); back-filled for legacy RTOs (D-11c).

Name: Product rto orders
Definition: Distinct orders with an RTO line of the product (D-22, D-37).

Name: Product shipping cost
Definition: Forward shipping cost (placed).

Name: Product taxes on net sales
Definition: GST on net sales, each line at its own rate; shipping at the order's line rate.

Name: Product thruplays (allocated)
Definition: ThruPlays allocated to the product line.

Name: Product video completion rate (allocated)
Definition: Allocated 100% views ÷ 3-second views.

Name: Product view events
Definition: Product view events.

Name: Product view rate
Definition: Sessions with a product view ÷ sessions.

Name: Provisional ops cost
Definition: Provisional one-lump operating cost estimate used until the actual split is posted (cost_status provisional).

Name: Qc actual units
Definition: Units actually received.

Name: Qc count
Definition: Quality checks.

Name: Qc damage rate
Definition: Damaged / actual received units.

Name: Qc damage units
Definition: Damaged units found at QC.

Name: Qc damage value
Definition: Damaged units x PO rate (ex-GST).

Name: Qc invoice units
Definition: Units on the vendor invoice.

Name: Qc shortfall rate
Definition: Short units / invoiced units.

Name: Qc shortfall units
Definition: Units short versus the invoice.

Name: Receipt layers
Definition: Receipt layers.

Name: Received units
Definition: Units received into the layer.

Name: Received value
Definition: Landed value of everything received.

Name: Refund amount
Definition: Refund booked against orders placed in the period, incl. GST (gold total_refund_amount: includes cancelled and RTO value, as v2). Cash refunds are in payments; exchange credits are not refunds (D-01b). Cohort-only.

Name: Refund count
Definition: Refunds. Refunds of exchanged items are excluded: exchanges never enter return metrics (D-01); the refund date is a native cash clock and ignores date_axis (D-36).

Name: Refund lines
Definition: Refunded line items. Refunds of exchanged items are excluded: exchanges never enter return metrics (D-01); the refund date is a native cash clock and ignores date_axis (D-36).

Name: Refunded amount excl tax
Definition: Refunded amount ex-GST, by refund date. Refunds of exchanged items are excluded: exchanges never enter return metrics (D-01); the refund date is a native cash clock and ignores date_axis (D-36).

Name: Rejected quality checks
Definition: Quality checks with status rejected.

Name: Remaining units
Definition: Units of those layers still unconsumed.

Name: Remaining value
Definition: Landed value of the unconsumed units.

Name: Remove from carts
Definition: Remove-from-cart actions in sessions.

Name: Repeat customers
Definition: Persons with 2+ lifetime sale orders.

Name: Repeat rate
Definition: Repeat customers ÷ customers.

Name: Reserved units
Definition: Units reserved for open orders.

Name: Return cancel revenue
Definition: Cancelled + RTO + returned sales ex-GST.

Name: Return rate
Definition: Return rate = orders later returned ÷ orders placed. Cohort-only: refused on event_date (D-31); use order_date.

Name: Return recovered cogs
Definition: COGS recovered on refunds (product, packaging, shipping, gateway, RTO). Refunds of exchanged items are excluded: exchanges never enter return metrics (D-01); the refund date is a native cash clock and ignores date_axis (D-36).

Name: Return revenue
Definition: Sales of delivered orders returned ex-GST (positive deduction).

Name: Returned or cancelled orders
Definition: Returned or cancelled sale orders (as v2; RTO is separate since v3).

Name: Returned orders
Definition: Sale orders with a customer-returned line (D-22).

Name: Returned units
Definition: Units of customer-returned line shares (D-22).

Name: Returns excl tax
Definition: Returns value ex-GST, by refund date. Refunds of exchanged items are excluded: exchanges never enter return metrics (D-01); the refund date is a native cash clock and ignores date_axis (D-36).

Name: RTO cost
Definition: Reverse shipping cost of RTOs and returns (gold rto_cost); back-filled for legacy RTOs (D-11c).

Name: Rto orders
Definition: Sale orders with an RTO line (D-22).

Name: Rto revenue
Definition: Sales of shipped orders that came back (RTO) ex-GST (positive deduction).

Name: Sample units
Definition: Sample units ordered.

Name: Sample units in inventory
Definition: Sample units moved to inventory.

Name: Sampling products
Definition: Distinct sampling products.

Name: Sampling variant count
Definition: Sampling variants.

Name: Bounce rate (sessions)
Definition: Bounce rate = sessions without a product view ÷ sessions (the web_funnel bounce_rate definition), sliceable by traffic source, campaign, device and landing page.

Name: Session collection views
Definition: Collection views counted in session summaries.

Name: Page views (sessions)
Definition: Page views of web sessions, sliceable by traffic source, campaign, device and landing page (≈1.3 % below the daily mart page_views, which also counts session-less events).

Name: Session product views
Definition: Product views counted in session summaries (≠ product_view_events).

Name: Sessions
Definition: Web sessions.

Name: Shipping cost
Definition: Forward shipping cost (placed).

Name: Shipping revenue
Definition: Shipping charged to the customer ex-GST, an order-level revenue line (D-10).

Name: Shipping revenue reversal
Definition: Shipping revenue reversed on cancelled / RTO / Unknown orders (positive deduction, D-10a).

Name: Site search events
Definition: Site search events.

Name: Site searches
Definition: Site searches in sessions.

Name: Status changes
Definition: Status changes (pause / enable / archive …).

Name: Stock movements
Definition: Number of stock movements.

Name: Stock value fifo
Definition: Landed-cost value (ex-GST) of the units that sit in open FIFO receipt layers only. Today ~16 % of on-hand units are layered (the rest arrived as manual adjustments without a layer), so this UNDERSTATES total stock value; see layered_units and items_with_layer_gap.

Name: Stocked items
Definition: Stocked items (SKU x variant x warehouse).

Name: Taxes on net sales
Definition: GST on net sales, each line at its own rate; shipping at the order's line rate.

Name: Thruplays
Definition: ThruPlays (Meta).

Name: Total sales
Definition: Total sales INCLUDING GST at placement (paid + discounts); a separately labelled tax-inclusive figure (D-02b).

Name: Touches
Definition: Pre-purchase touches.

Name: Transactions
Definition: Cash payment transactions.

Name: Unit return rate
Definition: Unit return rate = units returned ÷ units ordered. Cohort-only: refused on event_date (D-31).

Name: Units cancelled
Definition: Units of cancelled line shares (D-22).

Name: Units in
Definition: Units added to stock (receipts, returns, positive adjustments).

Name: Units ordered
Definition: Units on sold lines before cancels / RTOs / returns (placement).

Name: Units out
Definition: Units removed from stock (sales, exchanges, negative adjustments).

Name: Units per order
Definition: Units ordered per order containing the product.

Name: Units rto
Definition: Units of RTO line shares (D-22).

Name: Units sold
Definition: Net units sold = units ordered − cancelled − RTO − returned.

Name: Vendor count
Definition: Vendors.

Name: Video completion rate
Definition: Video completion rate = 100% views ÷ 3-second views (Meta).

Name: Web events
Definition: Web events.

Name: Weight discrepancy cost
Definition: Courier weight-discrepancy charges; not recorded before 2026-09 (D-11a).
